text:
The sky above was a dull, slate gray, mirroring the iridescent sheen of a common crow perched on the windowsill. Inside the classroom, the atmosphere was warm and encouraging.

"Your recent assignment has been quite well done," the teacher said, leaning forward with a genuine smile, her eyes crinkling at the corners. "I was particularly impressed by the depth of your analysis."

The student shifted slightly in their seat, a mix of pride and relief washing over them. "Thank you," they replied, their voice steady but earnest. "I worked hard on it. I spent a lot of time researching the secondary sources."

The teacher nodded, reinforcing the positive feedback. "It really shows. Keep that momentum going."
